text:
Priya Rao: Quick ping 5 needs a design + a11y sanity for the Alerting "compact preview" changes. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/preview (frames: compact/preview-v5). Can you scan copy + focus behavior?

Ethan Wu: Saw the mock. Two things: 1) preview list is alphabetical still, 2) CTA says 'Apply' which confuses whether it's persisted.

Rina Patel: Agree on CTA. Suggest 'Save changes' to be explicit. Also the helper under the duration reads 'Quiet window' while other screens use 'Pause notifications' 5 pick one.

Carlos Mendes: Accessibility: when the preview toggles, screen readers get no context. Add an aria-live region like: 'Preview updated: Pager will receive alert first.' Also per-pill focus is missing 5 pills are grouped as one tab stop.

Priya Rao: Good calls. On copy let's standardize to 'Pause notifications' (PM ok with that). CTA -> 'Save changes'.

Ethan Wu: For ordering, can we show runtime order by default? If we can't compute it cheaply, show an icon with tooltip 'Simulated order' vs 'Runtime order'.

Rina Patel: For keyboard, implement per-pill role=button tabindex=0 and aria-pressed for toggles. Also include aria-posinset/aria-setsize on list items so SR users hear the order.

Carlos Mendes: Tiny CSS suggestion for focus ring: make it 3px solid var(--accent) and outline-offset 2px. Also ensure contrast on muted pill labels >= 4.5:1 on both light/dark.

UI-Bot: Reminder: add unit tests for aria-live announcements and keyboard nav (coverage: preview component).

Priya Rao: Action items: @Carlos update tokens & focus style, @Rina add ARIA attributes + tests, @Ethan prototype runtime/simulated toggle, I'll change copy and update the Figma CTA. Review Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:
